# AstryxDropdownMenu { #anylumino.AstryxDropdownMenu }

```python
AstryxDropdownMenu(
    items,
    *,
    label,
    variant='secondary',
    disabled=False,
    callbacks=None,
    **props,
)
```

Render a button-backed Astryx dropdown menu.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                                                      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | Default       |
|-----------|-----------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------|
| items     | Iterable\[Any\]                                           | Item records used by generated child components or static search sources.                                                                                                                                                                                          | _required_    |
| label     | str                                                       | Visible or accessible label for the component.                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | _required_    |
| variant   | str                                                       | Astryx visual variant.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | `'secondary'` |
| disabled  | bool                                                      | Whether the component should render disabled.                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | `False`       |
| callbacks | Iterable\[Callable\[\[ComponentWidget\], None\]\] \| None | Python callbacks invoked for frontend activations.                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | `None`        |
| **props   | Any                                                       | JSON-safe DropdownMenu props. Useful keys: button, isMenuOpen, menuWidth, hasChevron, className, and style. anylumino generates menu items from items and handles click callbacks. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/DropdownMenu>. | `{}`          |
